name: AnimatedPhysicalModel
description: A widget that animates changes in a physical model’s properties such as color, elevation, shape, and shadow over a given duration. Useful for smooth Material-style animations.
how_to_use:
AnimatedPhysicalModel(
  child: Container(width: 100, height: 100, color: Colors.blue),
  color: _isSelected ? Colors.red : Colors.blue,
  elevation: _isSelected ? 10 : 2,
  shape: BoxShape.rectangle,
  shadowColor: Colors.black,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose physical model will be animated.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The background color of the physical model.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate at which to place this physical model. Higher elevation casts bigger shadows.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape of the box. Can be rectangle or circle.

properties.name: shadowColor
properties.description: The color of the shadow below the physical model.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the child if it overflows the bounds.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate changes to properties.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating property changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut
